trade.name: Electrician
trade.description: Craftsmen Training Scheme (CTS) Electrician Trade covers electrical workshop safety, domestic and industrial wiring, transformer maintenance, and AC/DC rotating machine operations.

modules.title: Workshop Safety and Basic Electrical Tools

activities.title: Identification and Handling of Electrical Hand Tools & PPE
activities.instructions: Demonstrate the safe identification, inspection, and application of insulated combination pliers, wire strippers, neon testers, and safety gloves.

criteria.description: Inspection and proper wearing of Personal Protective Equipment (PPE)
Correct tool selection and physical condition verification (insulation check)
Technique in stripping insulation without damaging the conductor core
Workshop safety adherence, tool cleanup, and storage protocol

activities.title: Making Western Union and Married Joints in Copper Conductors
activities.instructions: Prepare single-strand copper cables, execute a Western Union joint with mechanical tension strength, and solder and insulate properly.

criteria.description: Cable insulation stripping and conductor burnishing
Joint geometry, twist tight coupling, and tensile strength
Soldering technique, flux application, and cooling without voids
Insulation taping with 50% overlap and aesthetic finish

activities.title: Staircase Wiring Circuit with Two-Way Switches
activities.instructions: Install and test a staircase lighting installation controlled from two independent locations using two 2-way switches and a lamp holder.

criteria.description: Wiring diagram interpretation and circuit layout marking on board
Phase switch connection compliance (Phase wire connected to switch line)
Pre-energization continuity and insulation resistance test with Megger
Operational verification: two-way control operation from both stations

activities.title: Installation and Testing of Miniature Circuit Breakers (MCB) and RCCB
activities.instructions: Mount an MCB and Residual Current Circuit Breaker (RCCB) on DIN rail, wire distribution board, simulate earth leakage, and measure tripping time.

criteria.description: Mounting DIN rail and secure terminal clamping with correct torque
Polarity and earthing busbar connections verified
Test button operation and leakage current tripping trip verification
Neat dressing of input and output cables inside distribution box

activities.title: Direct-On-Line (DOL) Starter Wiring for 3-Phase Squirrel Cage Motor
activities.instructions: Connect a 3-phase induction motor using a DOL starter with contactor, start/stop push buttons, and thermal overload relay.

criteria.description: Identification of motor terminal leads (U1, V1, W1, U2, V2, W2) and star connection
Control circuit wiring (Stop push button, Start push button, auxiliary contact)
Overload relay current rating calibration according to motor nameplate
Direction of rotation test and motor running current measurement using clamp meter
